analysis: Validation HR@10 increased from 0.625 to 0.635 (+0.010), meeting the lower experimental target. However, the host reports 55 completed epochs and selection at epoch 35, versus the baseline’s epoch 10/30, so the improvement cannot be attributed solely to residual scaling. Learned scales initialized at 0.1 reduce initial convolutional contributions; improved generalization remains a hypothesis. No test results were provided.
code_summary: Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional item and positional embeddings, maximum length 128, and four shared residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8] applied twice. Each block retains two kernel-3 causal convolutions, LayerNorm, GELU, and dropout 0.2, adding a learned per-channel residual scale initialized at 0.1. The scales add 256 parameters and are reused across both passes. Padding masks, final normalization, dot-product scoring, interfaces, and hyperparameters are preserved.
